_note: Synthetic documents for evaluating conflict detection. Invented data; the values mean nothing about real machines.

documents.text: Hydraulic Press HP-80 standard operating procedure. The working pressure is 180 bar. Replace the hydraulic return filter every 500 operating hours. Hydraulic oil temperature must stay below 60 degrees C during operation. The oil tank holds 250 litres. Change the hydraulic oil every 4000 operating hours. Inspect the ram seal every week.
Press maintenance plan, planner's copy. The hydraulic return filter is replaced every 250 operating hours. The hydraulic oil must not exceed 70 degrees C. Lubricate the guide rails every 40 hours.

Air compressor AC-30 manual. The safety relief valve opens at 11 bar. Drain the condensate tank daily. The compressor oil capacity is 4 litres. Before shutdown run the unloaded compressor for 5 minutes. Replace the air filter every 2000 operating hours.

Compressor service sheet. After service set the safety relief valve to open at 10 bar. Oil capacity: 4 litres. Replace the air filter every 2000 operating hours. After full-load operation run the loaded compressor for 15 minutes before shutdown.
Conveyor CV-2 manual. Lubricate the drive chain every 24 hours. Tighten the gearbox mounting bolts to 45 Nm. Change the gearbox oil every 3000 operating hours.
Conveyor weekly checklist. Lubricate the drive chain every 8 hours. Tighten the gearbox mounting bolts to 60 Nm.
Site lubrication standard, applies to all machines. Lubricate every conveyor drive chain every 40 hours.
CNC lathe CL-200 manual. Change the spindle oil every 1000 operating hours. Check the spindle oil level daily.
Gearbox GB-4 SOP, part A. Drain the hot oil and wait 10 minutes before opening the drain plug.
Gearbox GB-4 SOP, part B. Drain the cold oil and wait 5 minutes before opening the drain plug.
Coolant care, summer. In summer check the coolant concentration every 4 hours.
Coolant care, winter. In winter check the coolant concentration every 8 hours.
Circulation pump P-6 SOP, revision 1. After stopping the pump wait 30 minutes for the casing to cool before removing the cover.
Circulation pump P-6 SOP, revision 2. After stopping the pump wait 45 minutes for the casing to cool before removing the cover.
Steam boiler SB-5 start-up procedure (2019). Allow the boiler to purge for 10 minutes before ignition.
Steam boiler SB-5 start-up procedure (2024). Allow the boiler to purge for 5 minutes before ignition.
Furnace F-8 manual. Allow the furnace to cool for 2 hours before opening the door.
Furnace F-8 manual, new edition. Allow the furnace to cool for 30 minutes before opening the door.
Hydraulic accumulator SOP. Allow ten minutes for the accumulator to discharge before disconnecting any hose.
Shutdown checklist. Wait at least 3 minutes after shutdown for the accumulator pressure to bleed off before removing a hose.
Dryer SOP. Wait 1 hour after shutdown before opening the dryer cover.
Dryer checklist. Wait 60 minutes after shutdown before opening the dryer cover.
Valve note A. Wait 5 to 10 minutes after closing the isolation valve before opening the vent.
Valve note B. Wait 8 minutes after closing the isolation valve before opening the vent.
Electrical isolation A. Before maintenance lock the main isolator with your personal padlock.
Electrical isolation B. Before maintenance never lock the main isolator; only attach a tag to it.
